profile.headline: Principal Automation Engineer at DIRECTV
profile.summary: Senior QA Lead Engineer, with development experience. Specializing in Backend and Mobile Testing and automation of video stream OTT applications. Experience in Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methodologies, and leading offshore and onsite QA teams. Passionate about driving teams to development with mindset toward quality.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Participated in the development of the AT&T TV app as a developer on a Scrum Team, developing test automation scripts to validate features on the iOS and tvOS apps.

- Also tested the AT&T TV app, validating release candidate builds for iOS, Android, and Web. Developed and maintained End-to-End Appium client automation scripts to validate User Journeys.

- Led Community of Practice (CoP) meetings for Testers of the AT&T TV app. At CoP meetings, I helped align testers on best practices for tools, automation, and processes.

- Created test strategies to validate microservices on the OV platform.

-Championed efforts to onboard tools, such as Sealights. to help scrum teams test more efficiently by highlighting their test code coverage and quality risks.

- Managed a team of software engineers, helping them to develop and foster and quality-focused culture within their scrum teams.

positions.title: Principal Engineer 1 - Software Quality Assurance
positions.description:
- Developing automated test scripts for AT&T EG's Next Generation Platform, testing iOS devices, and Apple TV. Working with a framework building on top of Appium.
- Testing various projects for the Entertainment Systems group
- Creating test plans and assigning them to offshore test teams
- Creating automated test scripts using iTKO LISA and a custom-built Selenium WebDriver framework. Also using LISA's Virtualization Server functionality.
- Creating performance test scripts using JMeter, and integrating scripts in our Jenkins Continuous Integration server.

positions.title: Software Engineer - QA Automation
positions.description:
- Developed scripts that test web services across multiple brands.
- Integrated scripts in Bamboo to set up continuous delivery for builds.
- Participated in an Agile/Scrum team for one of our billing projects.
- Worked with: JIRA, Bamboo, Eclipse, SVN, Parasoft SOATest
- Languages used: Python, Java, SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a suite of web tools servicing our Merchant Services, Product Classification and Taxonomy teams. Our team primarily used the Agile method of software development. We worked in two-week iterations, doing development and testing when necessary to complete tasks on time.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed user interface to upload product data files into our databases.

positions.title: Associate Programmer
positions.description: Created web-crawlers in Java to parse html and extract data.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description: Tested Console and PC games. Reported bugs. Verified fixes.
